app.subtitle: Open-source SEGA console emulator for iOS.
app.localizedDescription:
Open-source SEGA console emulator developed for iOS.

Supported Systems:
• SEGA Genesis / Mega Drive
• SEGA CD / Mega-CD (requires BIOS files)
• SEGA 32X
• SEGA Master System
• SEGA Game Gear

Features:
• PicoDrive (Libretro) emulation core
• Metal-based rendering
• Modern SwiftUI and Liquid Glass interface
• On-screen touch controls and physical controller support
• Save states and screenshots
• Automatic cover art and game info via TheGamesDB

YDrive does not contain any game ROMs or BIOS files; you must provide your own legally obtained copies.

Source code: https://github.com/yigit4451/YDrive-Emulator

news.title: YDrive 1.0.2 Update
news.caption:
⚠️NOTE: The sharing feature only uses the native iOS Share Sheet. The app does not include or host any ROMs in any way.

YDrive 1.0.2 is now available!

• SEGA Game Gear Support: Full emulation support added for SEGA Game Gear titles.
• Grid & List Layouts: Switch between card grid and compact list views directly in the home library.
• ROM Sharing: Export and share selected games as .zip archives using the native iOS share sheet.
• Touch Input Fix: Resolved an input timing issue where button presses were triggering on touch release instead of touch down.
• Duplicate ROMs Fix: Resolved an issue where adding ROMs could cause duplicate entries in the game library.
• UI Refinements: Streamlined the Details view and moved metadata refresh into the ROM context menu.
